package.author: Dylan Coakley
package.description: Quick, simple but powerful cross-platform image editor.

en-GB.author: Dylan Coakley
en-GB.description: Quick, simple but powerful cross-platform image editor.
en-GB.longDescription: Photoflare is a cross-platform image editor with an aim to balance between powerful features and a very friendly graphical user interface. It suits a wide variety of different tasks and users who value a more nimble workflow. Features include basic image editing capabilities, paint brushes, image filters, colour adjustments and more advanced features such as Batch image processing.
en-GB.name: Photoflare
en-GB.releaseNotes:
✨ New & Improved
- Polish translation added (thanks @MikolajQ, #512). Japanese (thanks @coolvitto, #514) and German translations/layout were also updated.
- Theme selection now replaces icon selection in Preferences.
- Rulers are now off by default.
- G'MIC updated to v4.0.5.
- ARM support added for Linux .deb packages.
- Deb build helper updated to handle Ubuntu 26.04 dependencies.
🐛 Fixes
- Fixed a startup setting issue and added a handler for a missing XDG_DATA_DIRS (#511).
- macOS: fixed crashes when using certain filters, including with a transparent colour on modern macOS. An error popup now appears when a filter fails.
- macOS: dependencies are now bundled correctly in the installer, which also fixes a recursive bundling problem.
📦 Build & Packaging
- New CI workflows for Ubuntu, macOS, Snap and Flatpak builds.
- macOS runner moved to macos-15. The Intel runner was removed.
- Added a timeout for the G'MIC step on Linux and macOS.
🙏 Contributors
Thanks to @MikolajQ and @coolvitto for their contributions.

zh-CN.description: 快捷、简单却功能强大的跨平台图像编辑器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Photoflare 是一款跨平台的图像编辑器，旨在平衡强大的功能与极其友好的图形用户界面。它适用于各种不同的任务，以及看重更敏捷工作流的用户。其功能包括基础图像编辑能力、画笔、图像滤镜、色彩调整，以及批量图像处理等更高级的功能。
